findings.title: Default strategy test skips enabling rolling-updates feature
findings.body: In operator/src/test/java/org/keycloak/operator/testsuite/integration/UpgradeTest.java createInitialDeployment() returns early when updateStrategy is null without setting FeatureSpec enabledFeatures to rolling-updates, while the non-null path does enable it. The docs in this PR state the operator will fail unless rolling-updates is enabled. Consequence: the null/default-strategy parameterized cases run in a different feature configuration than the Recreate cases, so they either will fail once the gate is enforced or currently do not test the documented required configuration.

findings.title: Feature-disabled gate only tested for metadata, exit code never asserted
findings.body: In quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/UpdateCommandDistTest.java testFeatureNotEnabled only exercises update-compatibility metadata without --features, and only asserts the error text. The identical gate added in UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java is never exercised for the disabled case, and neither test asserts the documented exit code 4 (FEATURE_DISABLED) nor exit code 3 for incompatible versions. Consequence: a regression in the check-command gate or wrong exit code would go unnoticed, breaking the scriptable/GitOps contract documented in update-compatibility.adoc.

findings.title: Update strategy table documents no Rolling value
findings.body: In docs/guides/operator/advanced-configuration.adoc the section lists Supported Updates Types as Rolling Updates and Recreate Updates, but the Possible field values table only has <not set> and Recreate rows with no value to select rolling updates. Consequence: a reader cannot tell how to enable the rolling strategy from the docs, contradicting the preceding description.
